Fab rules: hardware/OpenAIO-Whoop.kicad_dru 'PTH annular ring 0.20', 'PTH pad holes 0.45 apart', 'PTH hole to copper 0.28', 'PTH pads, copper 0.40 apart' (broken by 0.05: D21 rule proposed).
derivation: Holes D0.50 finished (KiCad stock = Molex recommended hole; also passes a stripped 28-30 AWG motor wire as the old anchor hole did) at x -1.25 / 0 / +1.25, y 0; rings D0.90 = 0.50 + 2 x 0.20 (DRU annular), unused inner rings removed. Front (land side, phase copper side): solder areas without paste (hand soldering, like MotorPad_1.0x1.8mm_PTH0.5) as second pads of the same numbers: pads 1/3 x +-0.80..+-2.45, pad 2 x -0.45..0.45, all y -0.45..1.05 (ring bottom = area bottom, so the 0.50 mm iron halo to the FET drains is measured from y -0.45). Ring-to-ring copper 0.35 (needs the D21 exception, NextPCB asks 0.40 for THT bridging; the land is hand-soldered), holes 0.75 edge to edge (>= 0.45), hole to other-net copper 0.55 (>= 0.28), solder-area gap 0.35 (>= 0.15 SMD). Back (header side): B.Fab housing x -2.80..2.80, y -2.10..1.20 (+y = edge-side wall), B.CrtYd = housing U rings + 0.10. body = land extents (as MotorPad_1.0x1.8mm_PTH0.5); F.CrtYd = land + 0.10.
